description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'Product' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog'. The class provides methods to add and edit product information within the OpenCart eCommerce platform, including functionality for handling product details such as descriptions, categories, images, options, discounts, related products, attributes, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product in the OpenCart catalog module with methods to add and edit product data including related entities like descriptions, categories, images, options, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product in the OpenCart catalog module with methods to add, edit, copy, delete, and manage product variants, including all related data and SEO configurations.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product to the database, including related information such as descriptions, categories, filters, stores, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, SEO URLs, and layout. It returns the new product ID.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by its product ID, replacing associated data such as descriptions, categories, filters, stores, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product to the database, including descriptions, categories, filters, stores, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, SEO URLs, and layout. Returns the new product ID.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing product with a new SKU, status set to inactive, and overrides from the master product. It copies all related data and descriptions, effectively cloning the product.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product and all its related data from the database, including descriptions, categories, attributes, images, discounts, specials, SEO URLs, layouts, options, related products, rewards, reports, reviews, subscriptions, and more.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Creates a product variant by overriding specific attributes from a master product, maintaining relationships, and copying relevant data such as descriptions, attributes, categories, and other related info.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Modifies an existing product variant by applying overrides on top of a master product, updating descriptions, attributes, categories, and other related data accordingly.
